# OK Contract Renewal Roadmap Planning Workshop

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../../../README.md) • [Strategy](../../../../README.md) • [Workshops](../../../README.md) • [Sessions](../../README.md) • [Roadmap Planning](../README.md)**

> Roadmap planning workshop session for OK Contract Renewal initiative scheduled for November 4, 2025.
page_texts.2:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/README.md#workshop-purpose]

## Workshop Purpose

This workshop is designed to facilitate alignment between Gainwell and OHCA stakeholders around modernizing Medicaid service delivery through a solution-centric model that enhances program management, measurement, and improvement capabilities.

---
page_texts.3:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/README.md#workshop-details]

## Workshop Details

**Date**: November 4, 2025
**Duration**: 1 day
**Workshop Type**: Roadmap Planning
**Format**: Single group session (no breakout sessions)
**Participants**: Oklahoma OHCA Executive Leadership, Gainwell Leadership
**Facilitator**: TBD
page_texts.4:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/ok-contract-renewal-20251104/README.md#objectives]

## Objectives

- Define strategic roadmap for OHCA Contract Renewal initiative ($100M, 10-year scope)
- Align Oklahoma OHCA and Gainwell executive leaders on timeline and priorities
- Address three key workstreams:
    1. Gainwell's Cultural Workforce Transformation Solution
    2. Technology Optimization & Debt Elimination
    3. Platform and SDLC Tooling Modernization
- Identify dependencies and risks across workstreams
- Establish implementation milestones
